aisleLandmarks.AP1-AP7: Produce islands (onions, tomatoes, potatoes, fruit, avocados, citrus)

aisleLandmarks.A8: Oils, vinegar, sugar, flour, baking soda/powder, yeast
aisleLandmarks.A9: Spices, condensed/evaporated milk, baking chips, coconut milk
aisleLandmarks.A15: Snack bars, trail mix, nuts, tea
aisleLandmarks.A16-A17: Paper plates/bowls, foil, wrap, storage & trash bags, paper towels
aisleLandmarks.A34: Milk, cream, half & half, sour cream, cream cheese, refrigerated juice, creamers
aisleLandmarks.A36: Shredded/sliced cheese, bacon, deli lunchmeat, packaged seafood
aisleLandmarks.G14-G19: Personal care (bath, shave, hair, deodorant, oral)
